notice_then_cut.detail: Actual signed Alice/Bob community and Noise session. Native branches prove all finite premises; universal community and node-device premises follow from exhaustive singleton acceptance/stored-verdict checks and Inv.sound. Bob removal sends its real requirement closure and excludes his chat message; given notice empties rooms and retires the actual session. Pending and admitted Bob both retry the actual stored Noise request to the invite address.
